params.title: Pensioenaangifte
params.note: pension-filing-upa-mvp (2026-07-12): same statutory-filing shape as LoonaangifteFilingDetail (create->review->confirm->send, gated on an external precondition), but this schema ALSO carries a real FK (payrollRunId -> PayrollRun, the run the delivery reports on), so the layout follows the TimesheetDetail split instead: pf-status leads top-left with the prominent status/deadline/response facts, pf-related sits top-right at matching height to resolve and link the referenced PayrollRun, then pf-data runs below with the remaining record fields (period/fund/aanleverkenmerk/verzondenDoor), excluding payrollRunId since Related already resolves it. Same reasoning as loonaangifte for NOT using a stats-block: the vendored app-manifest-v2 schema's stat/stats-block `metric` only supports count/sum aggregation over a collection, which cannot echo a non-numeric field (enum/date) of the current object, so pf-status is a `data` widget instead -- schema-valid and functionally equivalent (prominent, top-of-page). No Files leaf: unlike LoonaangifteFiling, PensionFiling carries no retention/proof-of-filing fields (no retainedUntil/furnishedToRecipientDate equivalent) -- the response is captured in-record (responseStatus/responseMessage), not as an attached document. No calendar/comms leaves -- deadline is a plain date field, not an appointment/event linkedType. lifecycleActions expose controleren/bevestigen/verzenden/heropenen/corrigeren, controleren guarded server-side by PayrollRunApprovedGuard. Audit history is a sidebar tab.
